info.name: Addition of 10DLC number to the registered campaign

items.docs: Syniverse is required to update some MNO A2P platforms with the new added number for a given campaign, this enables  customers to manage  individual number to campaign associations when the numbers are NOT part of a number pool

info.name: Deletion of 10DLC number from the registered campaign

items.docs: Syniverse is required to update MNOs A2P platforms and remove the number for a given campaign, this enables  customers to manage  individual number to campaign associations when the numbers are NOT part of a number pool

info.name: Association of Campaign  with the Number Pool

params.name: numberPoolId
params.description:
Number Pool Id that represents the Number Pool. Depending on the number pool type, it will be
USE:
- **{CampaignID}-{NNID}** for CampaignId Nmber Pool Type (exmple: CYYYYYY-999000)
- **{SubID}-{NNID}** for SubId Nmber Pool Type. (example CUST_SYN1-999000)

params.name: numberPoolType
params.description: Type of Number Pool based on SubId or based on Campaign Id; Indicative

items.docs: Syniverse is required to update some MNO A2P platforms with the new Number Pool for a given campaign, enabling   customers to better manage campaigns with large groups of numbers. Number pools require carrier approvals and this API currently covers  2 types SubId and CampaignId.
